name: Soccer Goal Notifier
description: Announce goals in matches of the football teams you follow (GOAL! / MECHELEN 1-0 GENK / S. MICHEZ 22'), pushed live by sportapi.ai.
author: Alvin To

api_key.title: sportapi.ai API Key
api_key.description: Your sportapi.ai key (starts with sk_live_). Free plan: create one at sportapi.ai/dashboard.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Comma-separated sportapi.ai team slugs, e.g. "mechelen, barcelona". Spaces become hyphens ("Racing Genk" -> racing-genk).

goals_shown.title: Goals Shown
goals_shown.description: "all": every goal in a watched team's match, including goals against them. "selected": only goals scored by one of your teams.

trigger_duration_seconds.title: Trigger Duration (seconds)
trigger_duration_seconds.description: How long the goal stays on the board.

match.description: The match with the score after the last goal (or the next watched match, e.g. BARCELONA - ALAVES, when there was no goal in the last two hours)

scorer.description: Scorer of the last goal (empty until sportapi.ai lists it)
